notes.title: Game Character Hub PE: 3.12.0
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Version 3.12.0 is now live, bringing improved functions and Qol improvements.

[h2]Improved file recovery system[/h2]
[list]
[*] If GCH detects recovery files, a new window will appear asking you which recovery file you want to restore or discard.
[*] GCH no longer writes recovery files for unsaved characters upon closing if the user explicitly selected the option ("do not save - file will be lost forever").
[*] Small fixes on the recovery system.
[/list]

[h2]Item library manager[/h2]
[list]
[*] The item library manager now warns if some resource packs could not be verified
[*] Other small improvements on the interface.
[/list]

[h2]Quality of life improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Opening and saving large files will no longer freeze the UI.
[*] The opening of a large number of files can be halted by the user.
[/list]

notes.title: Game Character Hub PE: 3.11.0
notes.notes:
[h2]New features[/h2]

[h3]New library installation manager:[/h3]
[list]
[*]   You can freely choose to install, reinstall, or uninstall any resource pack.
[*]   You can also view the contents of each pack.
[*]   You will no longer have duplicate character formats installed (you need to install the pack upgrades for that).
[/list]

[h3]New grid export option:[/h3]
[list]
[*]   The export window now directly gives you the option to export each character sheet into a larger image, in a grid pattern.
[*]   In addition, the export window preconfigures each character sheet so they are exported properly for RPG Maker (only newly created characters can benefit from this feature).
[*]   For instance, RPG Maker walk and face sheets will be exported in a 4x2 grid by default.
[*]   All GCH resource packs have been updated to support this new feature.
[*]   If you don't want it, you can still disable this feature with a single click.
[/list]

[b]RPG Maker MZ generator parts are now shipped with GCH, and no longer require the semi-automated import. Please consider the terms of use for this asset as reminded below.[/b]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] GCH now warns you if you attempt to close a character while GCH is still exporting its sheets to PNG files in the background.
[*] This used to freeze the UI, which is no longer the case.
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bunch of issues that happened when reordering character sheets
[/list].

[h2]Technical notes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Improved log system. What is logged and where can now be controlled with environment variables.
[/list]

[h2]About RPG Maker generator parts
[/h2]
We remind you the terms of use for each RPG Maker asset:
[list]
[*] You need to own the corresponding RPG Maker. For instance, you need to own RPG Maker MZ to use its generator parts.
[*] And the characters made from the asset may only be used in RPG Maker (it can be any RPG Maker version).
[/list]

notes.title: Game Character Hub PE: 3.10.0
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Version 3.10.0 is now live, bringing exciting new features along with improvements and bug fixes.

[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Complete rework of the item library explorer. You can now open several tabs,
     navigate through folders faster and zoom in on the preview.
     Previewing a large file no longer freezes the window.
[*] Colorize dialog features a new coloration technique: 'color multiply'.
     It multiples color by another. In practice, it efficiently recolors the white parts of an item.
[*] ’Export under different hues' can use the color multiply technique.
[*] Can now customize a pre-built set of shapes, which can then be drawn like any other.

[*] 'Export under different hues' window asks for confirmation before closing.
[*] Improved user interface of Colorize tool.
[*] Improved color sliders visual aspect.
[*] The character generator window no longer freezes when a character is being generated.
[*] Writing the recovery file for large characters no longer freezes the user interface.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed rendering artifacts on large characters with zoom values lower than 1.
[*] Fixed mass png export that stopped exporting spritesheets of a character at the first discarded spritesheet.
[*] Upgraded Looseleaf license to Creative Commons 3, which allows commercial use outside RPG Maker engines.
[/list]

notes.title: RPG Maker MZ with GCH 3.9
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We hope you are all doing fine :)

In any case, we hope to cheer you up with good news: GCH 3.9 will bring support for RPG Maker MZ! We are pleased to show you this small snapshot:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26633391/414aefde7c1f27bc3ce099f7b3711c0b07b384ce.png[/img]

As you can see, you can import all the RPG Maker MZ character generator parts (of base RPG Maker MZ and its Character Generator DLC). This is a manual operation you need to do, GCH 3.9 cannot ship RPG Maker MZ parts just yet. Don't worry though, the import is pretty straight-forward :) !

[i]Beware, you will only be able to import RPG Maker MZ assets that are installed on your machine (so you need to own RPG Maker MZ).[/i] This, unfortunately, means that Debian / Ubuntu users won't benefit from RPG Maker MZ assets as it is not available on this platform.

[h3]When will it be released?[/h3]

Like GCH 3.8, this update is a cooperative effort with people from Degica. Some RPG Maker MZ files need to be fixed before the release of GCH 3.9. You need to wait at most a few more weeks.

[h3]Is it a free upgrade?[/h3]

GCH 3.9 is a regular GCH update. So yes, you will be able to upgrade from any GCH:PE version for free.

[h3]Other features[/h3]

Along with RPG Maker MZ support, GCH 3.9 will mainly bring support for larger sprites with the ability to zoom out more (from 100% zoom to 5%). Other small bug fixes are also included.

That's all, we hoped you enjoyed it!

notes.title: Game Character Hub: PE 3.4
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

We are pleased to announce the release of GCH: PE 3.4! This release contains a bunch of important features, as well as some improvements and bug fixes.

The main new feature is a new tool delivered along with GCH, called gch-import-mv-dlc. As it is stated by its name, this program is able to scan your RPG Maker MV installation and create GCH generator parts out of it! To use this new tool simply launch GCH and go to "File > Import resources..." and click on "Import RPG Maker MV DLC(s)" button on the window that popped up. Beware though: Only RPG Maker MV Kids generator parts are currently supported by this tool. New generator parts will arrive in a future minor update.

Here is the complete changelog:
[b]New features:[/b]
[+] GCH provides a new tool to easily import RPG Maker MV DLCs (the list of supported DLCs will grow over time).
[+] GCH provides a new user-friendly way to import custom resources. Go to "File > Import resources..." to check it out!
[+] GCH character generator now allows you to tune the frequency of each item color variation. As a result, characters with unusual skin and hair color are generated much more rarely.
[+] GCH can now open files whose format does not appear clearly in their filename (i.e. does not end with ".png" or ".gpf", etc...). The program makes a first read of the file to deduce the format and then reads the file normally.

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[/] Improved character generator UI.
[/] Improved item library indexing speed.
[/] "View > Show Grid" now affects every document, not just the active spritesheet.
[/] gchlib dump command now accepts an "-o" option to redirect the command output to a file.
[/] gchlib exec command now accepts a "-continue-on-failure" option.
[/] gchlib now forbids to have two references pointing to the same file.

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[-] Fixed the fact that the active sheet would change when adding an item from the library.
[-] Selected animation in animation player will no longer be reset when changing current spritesheet.
[-] GCH will no longer crash if the library indexer is still running when quitting.
[-] Fixed potential dangling references in gchlib.

Enjoy :)

notes.title: Game Character Hub :PE - VX Ace item fix and upcoming update news

We hope you will enjoy :)

notes.title: Game Character Hub :PE 3.1.0: Import custom resource feature and more
notes.notes:
[h1]V3.1.0 Patch note[/h1]

[b]New features:[/b]
[list][*]It is now possible to import custom resources via the user interface (File > Import custom resources) in addition to the command line tool.
Updated the user guide with explanations on how to use this new interface.
[*]Two new options are available for gchlib: -pck and -npck for gchlib list item. This can enumerate all the items that are (pck) or not (npck) in a pack.
[/list]

[b]Improved:[/b]
[list][*]Improved "Export as PNG" window. If the selected output file already exists, the spritesheet to export will be drawn over the existing image in the preview area.
[*]Improved user guide with explanations on how to properly export RPG Maker MV Face/Damage spritesheets (In section "2.5 - Export character").
[*]Added new frame mapping processes in the RPG Maker MV pack.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed a rare case where selecting frames would make GCH stop.
[*]Fixed the issue where changing the layer composition mode made the layer turn black.
[*]Fixed rare issue where the "Edit character's dimensions" window would crash if it was validated with some wrong input.
[*]Fixed RPG Maker VX Ace pack: the frame mapping processes were not properly configured.
[*]Fixed issue where the recoloring option that features HSL sliders in item explorer would not recolor properly.
[*]Fixed the frame mapping processes manager window: some parts of the window were not properly disabled for some settings.[/list]

notes.title: DLC issues resolved
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We wish you a happy new year :)

We come with some good news: the DLC issues have been fixed. We apologize again for the trouble it may have caused.
It is now possible to buy any DLC for any GCH version, even if you don't own both GCH versions. 
The DLCs you may own with the base GCH version are still available for free with the Portfolio version (and vice versa).

Last but not least, a new GCH update is planned for mid January. It contains a bunch of bug fixes (it notably fixes the layer composition mode issue) and provides a new user interface to help you import custom resources into GCH without having to use the command line tool. The next major update will bring Steam Workshop support.

notes.title: Temporary issue with DLCs
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We hope you had a nice Christmas :) 

As you may have noticed, since a few days, it has no longer been possible to purchase any base GCH or GCH-PE DLCs, unless one owns both versions of GCH. Be assured that this was not intended. It is the first time we released DLCs across several products, the issue comes from some misconfiguration on our end. 

We are sorry about that and we understand the frustration it may have caused. We are working closely with Valve to have this fixed as soon as possible. Considering this is the holiday season, it may not be fixed until [i]mid January[/i]. 

Trying to change some things on our end until we get a reply from Valve is not an option, as it will make the DLCs unplayable for those who have managed to buy them :/ Of course this would be unacceptable so we will keep things as they are until Valve replies. We will post another announcement when the issue is resolved. 

Note that this temporary issue only affects the DLCs. [i]Game Character Hub can still be purchased normally, and you can still purchase the DLCs if you own both versions of GCH[/i].

We apologise for the inconvenience, and we wish you a happy new year!

notes.title: Game Character Hub Demo Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are glad to announce that we have put together a Trial version of the Portfolio Edition :) This version is provided for free and allows you to test Game Character Hub. It is not time-limited so feel free to take all the time you need to fully test it! The only limitation is that you cannot export your work to PNG files. This means that you cannot use your work outside Game Character Hub unless you purchase the full version.

We hope you will enjoy it and be convinced by GCH's powerful character creation features :)

And last but not least, we wish you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year :) !

notes.title: Game Character Hub: Portfolio Edition - RPG Maker DS/DS+ & Second Story DLC release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are happy to announce the release of Second Story and RPG Maker DS/DS+ generator parts! Both were already available on the previous version of GCH, and now have been ported to the Portfolio Edition as well. A few words about each of them:

[b]Second Story[/b]:
[i]It's the first character asset pack created with no engine limitation. With this add-on, you can generate stylish pixel characters for use in any 2D game-creation software. Formatted and optimized for use with Game Character Hub, Second Story is both versatile and practical.[/i]

[b]RPG Maker DS/DS+ generator parts[/b]:
[i]Invoking the feel of SNES-era RPGs, this pack contain more than 150 new unique items to be used with RPG Maker VX Ace engine. We hope you will enjoy these new character parts in retro style :)[/i]

Both packs have been tailored to adapt to the Portfolio Edition advanced layer system: when generator parts are added to your document, their layers will be automatically inserted at the right position so that no superposition issues occur :)

As promised, these packs are provided for free if you already owned them in the previous version of GCH. We hope you will enjoy :)

notes.title: Loyalty Discount now Available
notes.notes:
Hi there,
A 50% loyalty discount is now available for all owners of Game Character Hub.  

We apologize for our delay in getting this set up.
If you've purchased Game Character Hub: Portfolio Edition in the past week that means you will have received the "launch" discount of 20% as opposed to the 50% loyalty discount. To make this up to you, we have come up with the following 2 options. 

You can either receive a free Game Character Hub DLC of your choice or an equivalent amount in RPG Maker Web store credit. Please email games@degica.com with your receipt and we will set this up for you.

We also wanted to mention that for a short period of time the "loyalty" discount was stacking with the "launch" discount. This would have allowed you to purchase GCH:PE at 70% off :O This was unintended but if you got the program at that super discount, congrats!

Our next update for GCH:PE will be to release the original GCH DLCs in PE format. If you own the original DLC, you will be able to use them in PE free of charge.

Expect to see Steam Workshop compatability following shortly after that. 

Thanks for your continued support!

The Game Character Hub Team

*The loyalty discount was available during the first 3 months of release

notes.title: GCH:PE Statement/Update
notes.notes:
Hi there,
There has been a lot of discussion over the weekend about Game Character Hub: Portfolio Edition.

The developer Sebastien Bini has just created a thread addressing some of the concerns and detailing what is in the new version:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/529830/discussions/0/312265782623798262/

Essentially, Game Character Hub: Portfolio Edition is a complete new product, and not just an upgrade to the original Game Character Hub. It's been rebuilt from the ground up to support RPG Maker MV and has a lot of improvements and tweaks. 

The developer is also committed to updating it for free for at least the next 2 years. Just like he did with Game Character Hub, he'll take feature requests from users and implement them.

We realize that some users may be upset as the MV update was originally going to be released last winter as part of Game Character Hub.
We apologize for the lack of communication on our part and any confusion it may have caused.

Here's how we're going to fix this:

1. Loyalty Discount
We are looking into setting up a 50% loyalty discount for any GCH owners who purchase GCH:PE. Any GCH owner that has already purchased GCH:PE will receive equivalent RPG maker store credit or a DLC pack. We will have more details on this shortly.

2. Free Trial Version
We'll be releasing a free trial version of Game Character Hub: Portfolio Edition in the next 1-2 weeks. It will be a fully featured 15 day trial so you will be able to see for yourself what the new Game Character Hub is like.

3. Future Updates
Sebastien plans on continuing to update Game Character Hub: Portfolio Edition. He's focusing on Steam Workshop support as well as improvements to the drawing tools. He's also welcoming user feedback and suggestions for improvements.

We really appreciate the support everyone has shown for Game Character Hub over the past few years. We hope you'll forgive us this honest mistake and join us in Portfolio Edition.

cheers,

The Game Character Hub Team
